column1: # v8 cell inventory. Tab-separated: cell_id, item, runner, tasks_dir, task, num_ctx, trials, est_gpu_s
# Read by results/v8/run_gpu_round.sh, which runs cells in ASCENDING est_gpu_s so a harness
# fault is found on a cheap cell. Estimates come from v7's measured 10-trial cells
# (results/v7/GPU_BUDGET.log, 560-3,399 s); item 2's are prefill-dominated and lower.
# Two cells can void their whole item and both are checked early by the runner:
#   - item 1 rests on the model emitting tool_calls at all (D8-3), proved by the ~60 s smoke gate.
#   - item 2 rests on 4.664 chars/token, measured on v5's filler not on prose (D8-7); the first
#     item2 cell is a 20k rung and the runner reads its achieved occupancy before paying for more.
# Item 6's hosted arm must be API-billed, not plan-bound: a plan harness reports no usage field
# and cannot produce a ledger. GLM 5.3 Flash over OpenRouter is the approved API-billed arm.
